description: Three lanes with a cobweb at x = 4: on the floor over soul sand, sprint into it and on through (sinking into the soul sand); at head height, walk into it and on through, then sprint-jump into it and on through; 2 blocks up, sprint-jump into it once and keep sprinting until out of it. Then with weaving, walk through the first again.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
